hero.sub: Advisory and brokerage for apartment owners across Portland, the Willamette Valley, and beyond. Whether you're selling, holding, or planning what comes next.

philosophy.headline: The goal isn't to close a deal. It's to help you make the right decision, even if that means waiting.
philosophy.body: Gerding Commercial Real Estate is built on more than fifteen years of brokerage experience helping Portland apartment owners through some of the biggest financial decisions of their lives.

owner.headline: I learned what an apartment building means to a family long before I ever sold one.
owner.intro: My parents owned a fourplex and a fiveplex. I watched them work hard to make those buildings successful — and I saw what that investment meant for our family. Years later, I had the privilege of selling those buildings for them and helping them grow their portfolio.
owner.quote: Apartment buildings aren't just assets. For most owners, they represent years of effort, real sacrifice, and a meaningful piece of your family's future.
owner.outro: I've been an owner myself for over ten years. And when it does come time to sell — I'm a tenacious negotiator. I know this market, I know the buyers, and I know how to get my clients the outcome they deserve.

howIWork.headline:
Thoughtful process.
Decisive execution.
howIWork.sub: Good advice starts with understanding the owner, not just the property. Whether you're thinking about selling today or simply weighing your options, the goal is to help you make the right decision for the long term.

steps.title: Listen
steps.body: Every property serves a purpose. Understanding its role in your investment strategy, your financial goals, and your plans for the future is where the conversation begins.

steps.title: Advise
steps.body: Selling isn't always the right answer. Understanding the market, evaluating the available options, and weighing the potential outcomes helps determine the best path forward.

steps.title: Negotiate
steps.body: Listing a property is the easy part. A successful sale depends on choosing the right buyer, defending your price, and knowing when to stand firm and when to bend.

steps.title: Beyond Closing
steps.body: The relationship doesn't end at closing. From rental rates and refinancing to future acquisitions and sales, Gerding CRE remains a resource for the decisions that come next.

howIWork.quote: The right advice isn't always to sell. But when the time comes, the right execution makes all the difference.
